name: Balaji Flowers
what_they_do: Florist specialising in fresh flowers, hand-tied wedding garlands and Hindu pooja items, with festival pre-orders (Karthigai Deepam, Thanksgiving) and event decoration. Runs an e-commerce site with area-based pricing for three stores (North Brunswick NJ, Edison NJ, Herndon VA), pickup, local delivery, USA shipping and DoorDash delivery.
customers: South Asian households and temples buying garlands and pooja items, wedding parties (muhurtham garlands), and event/gift buyers across NJ and VA; also shipping customers nationwide

size_signals.signal: Three locations in two states with distinct hours and phone numbers (Edison, North Brunswick, Herndon VA)
Separate Florist schema entries per store with geo coordinates and daily 9-9/10-8/10-9 hours
Live e-commerce catalogue by category (flowers, garlands, pooja, festivals, weddings, decorations), cart, accounts, shipping/returns/FAQ policy pages and FedEx tracking hand-off
DoorDash storefront and a dedicated WhatsApp ordering number

listing.reviews: 28 (per Birdeye aggregation; not shown in limited Maps view)

website_review.primary_cta: 'SHOP KARTHIGAI DEEPAM' / 'ALL FESTIVALS' on hero; cart icon; per-category shop links
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Full online ordering with cart, area/store selection, delivery or shipping, plus WhatsApp chat; no calendar booking for wedding consults
website_review.trust_signals: 'Fresh each morning, hand-tied the day of your order', real arrangement photography, three-store address/hours block, FAQ, shipping and returns policies, 4 social channels
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Nothing stale - copyright '© 2026', festival pre-orders dated Nov 23, seasonal (Thanksgiving) merchandising current
website_review.search_basics: Titles and descriptions name flowers, garlands, pooja items and all three towns; category pages for flowers/garlands/pooja/festivals/weddings/decorations; per-store Florist JSON-LD with address, hours, geo and areaServed - best in this batch
top_issues: The North Brunswick Google profile has no website link and prompts 'Add missing information' / 'Add photos', so this branch's listing looks unclaimed while the site is well built
Booking a wedding garland consultation still means WhatsApp or phone; there is no date/time request form that captures ceremony date, length, flower type and budget
No visible order-status or delivery-window tracking on the site beyond a FedEx tracking hand-off for shipped orders

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: site-side markup is excellent (per-store Florist schema, hours, geo, areaServed) but the North Brunswick Google profile is missing the website link and photos and looks unclaimed, so the local entity is weaker than the website. Answerable: prices, hours, three addresses, delivery/shipping/returns and festival dates are all real text, and the 'ASK BALAJI' chat launcher is present. Bookable: an agent can add to cart, choose store/area, pay and arrange delivery or shipping online - closest to fully bookable in this batch.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the North Brunswick Google profile (website, hours, photos, service list) and re-run review requests - 3.8 from 28 reviews understates a well-run shop
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps panel shows 'Add website' and 'Add missing information'; rating 3.8 with freshness and wrong-colour complaints noted in review aggregation

top_opportunities.opportunity: Garland/wedding order intake agent: capture ceremony date, garland length, flower type, delivery time and budget, then return a firm quote and confirmation - the exact points where reviews report errors
top_opportunities.evidence: Reviews mention dead or wrong-colour flowers on wedding orders; the site's wedding path is a product category plus WhatsApp, with no structured order spec

top_opportunities.opportunity: Post-order delivery updates (SMS/WhatsApp) for local delivery orders, since late delivery is a repeated complaint and shipped orders only get a FedEx link
top_opportunities.evidence: An older review complains of a late garland delivery; site offers only 'Track Order' to FedEx for shipped items

scores.reasons: Digitally the most advanced business in the batch (real schema, e-commerce, WhatsApp, DoorDash), so the gaps are narrow - mainly an unclaimed local profile and unstructured wedding intake; a three-store, two-state florist with festival spikes can fund work, but delivery runs through their own developer.
